title: Dead _owner_id field in DeliverHandler
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs line 106: DeliverHandler stores owner_id as a field and clones it on every call, but the clone is bound as `let _owner_id` (prefixed underscore signals intentional non-use). The field is never read inside the handler — owner_id is accessed only via the outbox_worker caller. The dead clone is noise and suggests the field was left behind after a refactor. Consequence: confusing to readers, suggests owner_id auth was meant to happen but was never wired up.
